test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the idiom that gives the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase in the following sentence.

Our Principal __looked disappointed__ when no one expressed the willingness to join the trip.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Pulled a long face**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**Pulled a long face**" means to look disappointed or sad.
 
• The sentence describes the Principal's disappointment when no one was willing to join the trip.
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and 4 do not convey the correct meaning in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Our Principal **pulled a long face**__ when no one expressed the willingness to join the trip."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Made a comeback"** is incorrect because it means to return to a previous state or position.
 
• **Option 3: "High and dry"** is incorrect; it means to be left in a difficult situation without help.
 
• **Option 4: "Gave a single shot"** is incorrect as it does not fit the context of the sentence.
